title: Midjourney
hero_prompt: A hand-painted oil canvas in the atmospheric manner of Turner: a woman painter stands at an easel on a cliff's edge at dusk, amber light and dust motes catching the canvas as its far edge dissolves into mist, loose atmospheric brushwork, warm ochre and violet dusk palette.
icon_prompt: Square bold emblem: a single black palette-and-brush silhouette half-dissolving into a soft sunburst, oil-painting texture reduced to bold flat high-contrast shapes, amber on dark ground, no fine linework.
